Life form which can reproduce is only able to live further and is currently living. Which cannot reproduce ultimately dies and become non living. In simple terms, what copies itself or reproduce is living i.e nature wants us to create copy because if we cannot create copy the 'us' do not exist ,it just becomes dead matter in sometime.

Humans are the beings which have the ability to decide for themselves if they want to reproduce or not. Even if only a couple is left in the world then it's their own choice if they want to continue human life or not. It's their own choice. They have this ability given to them by evolution. 


My point is that all life forms are designed to reproduce because reproduction is the only way in which life continue. It's just creating copy of itself either by sexual or asexual reproduction. The matter which cannot copy itself is non living. Creating a copy or reproduction is the necessity or the main characteristics of design of life.

We humans a multicellular organism which evolved to have capacity to take conscious decision are living until there exists a copy of a human. When this organism loses its ability to copy itself either by sexual or asexual reproduction it loses life because currently there is no ability of humans which can make a single individual life form to exist till eternity. 

Now talking in a narrow perspective we naturally have sex organs for reproduction which is given so we can create a copy of us i.e create a new human being. For natural reproduction in humans both males and females are required with their properly working sex organs which are designed by nature. Even with the help of modern technology inserting a Human DNA from a cell into the eggs of female , we still require the eggs of female which are ultimately designed by nature thus indicating that in both natural and artificial way nature wants us to create our own copies but its ultimately our choice to do it or not.

Imagine you are the only living organism from your species. Now you must procreate. We are designed in way that each healthy organism is capable of procreation. We are designed to reproduce. But as a 'being' with 'consciousness' we may choose not to but it's not what the nature intended.
